headline: Arisinfra subsidiary Unitern bags ₹250 cr Ramdev Plaza Phase II mandate
hook: Third major project mandate from Transcon
summary: Unitern, a subsidiary of Arisinfra, has secured a ₹250 crore mandate from Transcon for the Ramdev Plaza Phase II project in Mumbai. This is the third consecutive mandate awarded by Transcon to the company. The repeat order highlights growing traction for the firm's construction and procurement services in the Mumbai real estate market. Indian retail investors tracking real estate ancillary suppliers should note this steady order inflow.
why_it_matters: Order wins boost subsidiary revenue visibility for Arisinfra.

headline: Arisinfra's unit Unitern secures third Transcon mandate worth Rs 250 crore
hook: New order wins build order book
summary: Arisinfra Solutions announced that its unit, Unitern, has bagged its third mandate from Transcon for the Ramdev Plaza Phase II project in Santacruz. The project has a Gross Development Value (GDV) of Rs 250 crore. This contract adds to the ongoing project pipeline for the company's subsidiary. Retail investors holding the stock should note this as a regular operational update rather than a major financial earnings event.
whats_next: Quarterly financial results reporting project execution progress
why_it_matters: New project wins add steady revenue visibility for the company.

headline: Arisinfra Solutions schedules NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has issued a notice regarding an NCLT-convened meeting of its equity shareholders, scheduled to take place on November 25, 2026. This corporate procedure involves legal and regulatory oversight through the National Company Law Tribunal. Shareholders of the company are required to participate in the meeting as per the statutory notice. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should note this procedural timeline.
why_it_matters: Procedural corporate meeting requires shareholder participation.

headline: Arisinfra Solutions secures NCLT approval for first motion merger application
hook: First hurdle cleared in Arisinfra merger
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has approved its first motion application regarding a proposed amalgamation or merger. The company informed the stock exchange about this legal progression. This is an early procedural step in a multi-stage corporate restructuring process. Indian retail investors holding shares should note that the merger is still in early phases and requires further approvals before completion.
whats_next: Second motion application and final NCLT hearing
why_it_matters: Early procedural step with no immediate impact on share value
